timingMethod: Observed elapsed wall-clock interval for the batch, including official-source lookup and editorial changes. Individual item durations were not measured or allocated. This interval is not a sample of human editorial cost.
method: Read each bilingual fact and the generated forward/reverse choices. Confirm source support and original wording. Exclude parent/subtype distractor pairs and retain exact snapshot hashes. Structural checks complement the semantic review.

wikidata.basis: CC0 structured statements and labels; encyclopedia prose is not reused

iupac.basis: Names, symbols and atomic numbers only; no periodic-table artwork, layout or editorial text reproduced

nasa.basis: Independently written factual definitions and original schematic code; no NASA images or logos, no endorsement claimed

nca.basis: Copyrighted pages consulted as factual references; source paragraphs, compilation, artwork and trademarks are not licensed into this app

otherSources.basis: WSET, SCA, AWRI, Nespresso and Starbucks pages are factual references; their copyrighted text and media are not copied. No open license for those pages is asserted.

limitations: Editorial content review does not verify native rendering, accessibility or real-device interaction.
Coffee menu definitions describe conventional hot preparations; regional and individual recipes can differ.
Wine production definitions using generally or usually retain exceptions.
Capital information is time-dependent and must be refreshed before later releases.
